scope: Optimize 52-week-high-only Bayesian probabilities and allocation. No momentum features, no live trades.
data: Same raw snapshot through2026-07-31; adjusted closes, volumes, historical membership, dates, benchmark for risk only. This history has already been inspected in earlier research; no claim of pristine OOS.
universe: Same A=P/max252close; new entry A>=.90 and top10%, retain A>=.90 and top20%; max20names, positive-volume tradability, no fixed maturity exit. Daily membership exits; otherwise review every5sessions. Unknown current ranks lock existing positions.
main_change: Remove absolute-return probability entry/exit gates and free cash optimization. Bayesian relative-expected-return probability only tilts weights among eligible high52 stocks; weak conviction reverts to equal weight rather than cash. Target gross98%, limited by eligible-name count times stock cap and locked positions. No guarantee of98% when candidates scarce or fills fail.
relative_probability: Reuse causally computed NIG posterior at H5/20 W504/1008. For eligible basket S, a_i=sigma_i sqrtH X_i, delta_i=a_i-average_S(a). p_i=P(delta_i beta>0|D) computed from Student-t marginal using shared posterior covariance. This is probability of above-basket-average latent expected return, NOT probability of realized positive trade return.
weights: deadzone p0 in[.50,.55,.60]. s_i=sign(p_i-.5)*max(abs(p_i-.5)-(p0-.5),0)/(1-p0). desired weights proportional exp(strength*s_i), strength in[.5,1]. Equal control strength0. If all uncertain weights equal. Clip via cost-aware constrained projection.
allocation_optimization: min 0.5||w-v||^2 + lambda*(buy_cost*sum(w-u)+ +sell_cost*sum(u-w)+), sumw=feasible98%budget,0<=w<=cap. Lambda[1,3]; cap[.06,.08,.10]. Exact scalar-dual proximal solution, no extra posthoc band. Same constraints and costs for matched equal control; this is target tracking with turnover penalty, not unconstrained expected-return maximization.
grid: 4 posteriors x3 deadzones x2 tilts x3caps x2costpenalties =144 Bayesian settings, plus6 equal controls. Freeze all before results.
selection: Development starts original common warmup2009-08-07 through2016. Evaluate all5 review phases, never select best phase. Fit2009-2013: require positive phase-averaged monthly log excess over matching equal control; validation2014-2016: NIG posterior for monthly log excess, m0=0,kappa0=12,a0=3,b0=.0008. Rank eligible by10th percentile of latent mean excess, then phase-mean validation Sharpe. If no fit-positive candidate rank all but label it unqualified. Select one diagnostic optimized setting, and retain best3 with same cap/lambda for adaptive ensemble. Write frozen selection before evaluating2017+.
bayesian_setting_mix: From2017, update monthly on at most36 fully completed months of each source candidate minus matched equal shadow portfolio monthly log return; average differences over5 review phases BEFORE posterior update, not5x sample count. Prior same as selection. Let a_c=max(P(mean excess>0)-.5,0), blend g=min(.5,2*mean(a)); source weight g*a/sum(a); equal weight1-g. Thus >=50% of target comes from equal model; zero confidence means equal, never cash. Selected3 candidates frozen using development only. These are heuristic posterior-confidence allocation weights, NOT marginal-likelihood posterior model probabilities.
evaluation: 2017-2021 test,2022-2026July follow-on; all reported new account comparisons start flat cash1e7 at2017phase0 or phase offsets0..4. No resets at2022. Source shadow accounts may use full causal history for parameter confidence. Report fixed optimized, matched equal, default equal(cap8 lambda3), adaptive mixture, and prior Bayesian separately with accounting dates disclosed.
